Access Ticket statuses Agent availability Data sharing for tickets The default access to tickets owned by other agents. Private Current Agents see and edit the tickets they own, their teams' tickets and their subordinates' tickets — plus unassigned tickets when their profile allows it. Public Read Only Agents see every ticket in the public scope below, but edit only what Private would let them edit.
